purpose: Test narrow stricter _sync_directory candidate through actual unchanged sink control flow and pure lifecycle warning mapping; resolve caller side effects before any product patch.

copy_contract.baseline: Copy exactly six pinned local modules to dedicated baseline source directory; no source edits.
copy_contract.candidate: Same six module bytes except replace only filesystem module with exact pinned 31040-byte candidate.
copy_contract.import_resolution: -I -B; explicitly insert only current variant source-copy directory for these six module names; verify each loaded __file__ and digest; no imports from retained originals. Clear six app modules between variants or use a clean controlled entrypoint, but do not add worker/helper processes to this scope.

dependency_footprint.not_included: file_pipeline/local_service/crypto/profile/vault/GUI modules; lifecycle lazy classifier/pipeline imports must not be triggered

injection_contract.mechanism: Only copied filesystem module os binding replaced temporarily with delegating proxy that injects selected fsync and records component os.open descriptors; do not patch process-wide os.fsync or change source bytes. All nonselected operations delegate exactly once.
injection_contract.selector: Exact direct code boundary _sync_directory with immediate caller _create_private_temp/commit/abort, own held-directory descriptor identity/kind, and per-action ordinal. Pin function code/segment hashes and fail if no exact boundary.

boundaries.constructor_directory: _create_private_temp → _sync_directory → fsync; directory call1 during construction, after journal regular fsync and acquired writer lease
boundaries.commit_directory_1: commit → _sync_directory → fsync; first directory sync after actual link L and object verification
boundaries.commit_directory_2: commit → _sync_directory → fsync; second sync only after first success and both residue unlinks
boundaries.abort_directory: abort → _sync_directory → fsync; only after both residue names removed

injection_contract.matrix_limit: Three swallowed errno values tested at constructor and first post-L sync; EINVAL at second post-L and abort; EIO at first post-L and abort. Not full cross-product.
injection_contract.must_not_inject: journal regular-file fsync, seal regular-file fsync, file opens, writes, unlink, hardlink, flock, descriptor closure, observer, or initial synthetic reason

effect_budget.read_only_originals: Read/hash source, catalogue, review files, and harness/runtime identity only. No original imports, changes, apply, commits, tags, dependency installs or updates.
effect_budget.writes: New report/harness/source copies and fresh own synthetic case directories only under a new work root inside this analysis workspace. No existing Dell or external paths.
effect_budget.native_actions_later_only: Own named regular files, owner directory, normal fsync, POSIX flock, hardlink no-clobber, unlink and close. Failure fsync calls are mocked.
excluded: process synchronization or adversarial worker processes

guards_before_and_after: Pinned six input bytes and candidate digest match; source snapshots unchanged.
All 263 catalogue-listed current source files hash to original binding using G02 overlay for the two overlay paths; never import originals.
Copied baseline/candidate digests exactly as frozen; only intended one function differs; actual loaded modules are selected copied modules.

Caller runtime is reported honestly; local runtime not claimed as pinned Dell Python3.12.3. Use -I -B, no bytecode, no optimize and equal uid/euid; root is permitted solely for fresh own-file observations and must be recorded with explicit no unprivileged/isolation/prevention claim; no install.
Case roots are new owner-controlled 0700 directories; each case uses its own files, exact payload and sentinel basenames; no symlinks/hardlinks inherited from outside.
Track own component descriptors and exact fixture objects; post-case readout before any teardown. Real unrelated sentinel and retained-input bytes and identity must remain unchanged.
Restore copied module os binding and ensure no global standard-library mutation remains.
Raw count must equal all 14 aliases for both variants or explicitly report missing cases; a guard refusal is not application success.
Final original source/candidate/catalogue hashes unchanged; no original apply or runtime update.
open_gates_unchanged: All mandatory Linux/Windows/Mac physical cells remain required, including EN-P02/P03/P04
followup: Parent reviews this frozen scope/oracle before any harness implementation or case execution. GitHub independent confirmation may mirror exact accepted inputs later; no workflow created here.

local_runtime.limits: Own-file component observations valid only in recorded identity; zero evidence of unprivileged access prevention, real attacker isolation, Dell3.12.3 or cross-platform acceptance.
